text: REITAN AS is owned by Odd Reitan and his sons Ole Robert Reitan and Magnus Reitan, with their families.
short: REITAN AS is owned by Odd Reitan and sons Ole Robert and Magnus Reitan with family.

source.name: Reitan: Våre eiere (Our owners)
source.quote: REITAN AS eies av Odd Reitan og sønnene Ole Robert Reitan og Magnus Reitan med familie.
source.note: English: 'REITAN AS is owned by Odd Reitan and the sons Ole Robert Reitan and Magnus Reitan, with family.'
